tagline.en: Your everyday Mac tools, tied together.
tagline.zh: 把每天都用的 Mac 工具，系在一起。

description.en: Knot is a focused native Mac utility that brings search, commands, menu-bar organization, window management, clipboard history, screenshots, OCR, and Quicklinks into one lightweight entry point. It is local-first, has no account system, and asks for system permissions only when a feature needs them.
description.zh: Knot 是一款轻量的原生 Mac 工具，把搜索与命令、菜单栏整理、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、截图、OCR 和 Quicklinks 收进同一个入口。它默认在本地工作，无需账号，并且只在功能需要时请求系统权限。

en: Fast global search for apps, commands, files, and Quicklinks
Menu-bar organization with a simple collapsible hidden section
Keyboard-driven window layouts with configurable shortcuts
Encrypted local clipboard history for text and images
Screenshots, in-place annotation, and on-device OCR
Configurable global shortcuts, including Command-Shift-V for clipboard history
zh: 快速全局搜索应用、命令、文件和 Quicklinks
用简洁的折叠区域整理菜单栏图标
通过可配置快捷键管理窗口布局
在本地加密保存文字和图片剪贴板历史
支持截图、原地标注和设备端 OCR
全局快捷键均可配置，剪贴板历史默认为 Command-Shift-V

troubleshooting.en: Window commands need Accessibility permission. Capture and OCR need Screen Recording permission. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, grant the requested permission to Knot, then run the command again.
troubleshooting.zh: 窗口命令需要辅助功能权限；截图和 OCR 需要屏幕录制权限。请在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”中为 Knot 开启相应权限，然后再次执行命令。

summary.en: Privacy policy for the Knot macOS utility.
summary.zh: Knot macOS 工具的隐私政策。
